fields.hero_subhead: Sagging, sticking, or smashed storefront door? We repair the glass, closers, pivots, and panic hardware on aluminum entrance doors, across the GTA.
fields.overview_heading: Storefront doors that close and lock right
fields.overview_body:
A storefront door that drags, will not latch, or has cracked glass is a daily problem and a security risk. SolidGuard handles storefront door repair across Toronto and the GTA: door glass, closers, pivots, and panic and exit hardware on aluminum storefront and entrance doors. Most issues are a hardware or glass fix, not a new door.

From a worn closer that slams to a smashed commercial glass door after a break-in, our commercial door repair covers the glass and aluminum side: pivots, hinges, locks, panic devices, and auto operators. We work on aluminum storefront door systems and commercial entrance doors. We do not service overhead or roll-up metal doors.

faqs.question: My storefront door will not close properly. Can you fix it?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. A door that drags or slams is almost always a worn closer or sagging pivot, both of which we repair without replacing the door.

faqs.question: Do you repair the glass in a commercial glass door?
faqs.answer: Yes. We replace cracked or smashed door glass with tempered safety glass cut to fit your existing aluminum door.

faqs.question: Do you service panic bars and exit devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. We repair and replace panic and exit hardware so your entrance stays code-compliant and secure.

faqs.question: Do you fix overhead or roll-up metal doors?
faqs.answer: No. We handle glass and aluminum storefront and entrance doors only, not overhead, roll-up, or garage doors.

faqs.question: Can you secure the door after a break-in?
faqs.answer: Yes. We board up to secure the opening the same day, then return with the glass and hardware once parts are confirmed.

faqs.question: Do you cover the whole GTA?
faqs.answer: Yes, across Toronto and the GTA, fully insured with police-cleared technicians.
